name: Best Agrolife Ltd
title: Best Agrolife Ltd - 539660 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue fell 31% to ₹1,257 crore and Q4 EBITDA was negative ₹27 crore, with a ₹50–70 crore March sales deferral and 2 price hikes as the recovery case; no numeric FY27 guidance.

utilisation.quote: our capacity utilization going up to 80-90% during the season and off season we are at around 50-60%

capex.quote: we are postponing the newer capex which we are supposed to do in our existing plant. So, that we are keeping it on hold.

triggers.label: New plant capex put on hold
triggers.quote: we are postponing the newer capex which we are supposed to do in our existing plant

triggers.label: Two rounds of price hikes Apr–May
triggers.quote: the Company implemented two rounds of price increases during April and May 2026

triggers.label: Inventory ₹958cr → ₹651cr
triggers.quote: inventory levels have reduced significantly from approximately ₹958 crore in FY24 to ₹773 crore in FY25 and further to ₹651 crore as of March 31, 2026

triggers.label: Q4 revenue down 43% YoY
triggers.quote: revenue from operations for Q4 FY26 stood at ₹156 crore as against ₹274 crore in Q4 FY25, representing a decline of 43% year-on-year

triggers.label: Receivables and bank line at 85–90%
triggers.quote: our utilization of the bank facilities it is at around 85-90%

guidance.quote: for next year we are not giving any specific number on the guidance part

prior_guidance_check.quote: we thought in our earlier guidance that Q4 will have minimal losses

red_flags.label: Missed Q4 guidance; losses doubled
red_flags.quote: you have even doubled the losses compared to year on year

red_flags.label: Receivables ~50% of sales; >6-month debt ₹200cr+
red_flags.quote: you have receivables worth of 500 crores and the sales are roughly 1000 crores

red_flags.label: Bank lines 85–90% utilised
red_flags.quote: our utilization of the bank facilities it is at around 85-90%

red_flags.label: Sales return ~20–21% of sales
red_flags.quote: Presently we are at around 20 -21% of sales return

red_flags.label: Poor audio quality; answers partly inaudible
red_flags.quote: your answers have been inaudible to many of us throughout the call

evasions.quote: for next year we are not giving any specific number on the guidance part
So, the B2C cycles are quite long.
